entry.name_in_paper: Human Cytokine Array/Chemokine Array 71–403 Plex Panel (HD71)

evidence.quote: Sera were shipped to Eve Technologies (Calgary, Alberta, Canada) on dry ice, and levels of cytokines and chemokines were measured with Human Cytokine Array/Chemokine Array 71–403 Plex Panel (HD71).

Human Cytokine Array/Chemokine Array 71–.reason: This is a product/panel name rather than an assay technique name.

evidence.quote: Percentage viability was estimated using standard Trypan blue staining and an automated cell counter (Thermo-Fisher, #AMQAX1000).

Trypan blue staining.reason: This is a sample quality/quantity check rather than an assay under the stated rules.
